import numpy as np
import openmdao.api as om
import pycycle.api as pyc

# ---- define a simple turbojet cycle ----
class Turbojet(pyc.Cycle):
    def setup(self):
        # design point station definitions (fractions of total flow)
        self.pyc_add_airflow_source('.Fl', 1.0)

        # Tabular thermo data
        self.options['thermo_method'] = 'TABULAR'
        self.options['thermo_data'] = pyc.AIR_JETA_TAB_SPEC

        f_a = self.pyc_add_flow_station('Fc', ['Fl'])
        f_c = self.pyc_add_compressor('comp', ['Fc'])
        f_b = self.pyc_add_combustor('comb', [f_c])
        f_t = self.pyc_add_turbine('turb', [f_b])
        f_n = self.pyc_add_nozzle('nozz', [f_t], 0.99)

        self.pyc_add Shaft = None  # placeholder"
